entries.title: Behavioral tail-demand / maker settlement rent
entries.watch_reason: New academic mechanism evidence is research-positive, but transfer to current executable Kalshi/target-venue economics is unproven.
recheck_triggers: new own maker-fill dataset with price-bucket/category labels
prospective queue/fill and post-fill markout evidence
inventory-to-settlement PnL evidence including fees/rewards
new venue incentive or fee regime materially changing maker economics
preserved_negative_evidence: maker status alone is not edge
favorite-longshot bias alone is not a direct trading rule
adverse selection and settlement inventory risk must be measured

entries.title: Multi-DCM route fragmentation through one frontend
entries.watch_reason: Multiple underlying DCM routes exist, but no synchronized route-resolved executable price difference or exact payoff identity has been demonstrated.
recheck_triggers: route-resolved simultaneous bid/ask or L2 becomes available
provably identical cross-DCM contract pair is identified
routing policy, fee schedule or venue eligibility changes
material route-specific spread/depth/fill divergence appears
preserved_negative_evidence: same frontend or title does not prove same contract semantics
smart routing may eliminate rather than create fragmentation

entries.title: ForecastEx block/RFQ versus visible CLOB
entries.watch_reason: Block trading, proposed fee holiday and liquidity-retainer changes are real regime changes, but user access and executable economics are unproven.
recheck_triggers: block/RFQ participant eligibility and minimum size confirmed compatible with project constraints
fee holiday becomes effective or fee schedule changes
synchronized RFQ/block quote and CLOB depth can be compared
liquidity-retainer program materially shifts executable strike liquidity
preserved_negative_evidence: fee holiday alone is not edge
off-book liquidity cannot be inferred from displayed CLOB
access/minimum-size constraints may make the route non-executable

entries.title: Nadex/CDNA zero-maker-fee, rebates and finer ticks
entries.watch_reason: New market-maker, volume-incentive, fractional-unit and tick rules may alter microstructure but current net execution advantage is unproven.
recheck_triggers: program implementation becomes effective
participant eligibility and quoting obligations become compatible with project scale
realized rebate/fee schedule can be measured
executable books show persistent small positive maker economics after adverse selection
preserved_negative_evidence: zero maker fee plus finer tick does not imply positive EV
new incentives may compress rather than create inefficiency

entries.title: Polymarket live-sports combinatorial arbitrage
entries.watch_reason: External research shows executable episodes can exist, but they are short-lived and depth-constrained; small capacity is no longer a rejection criterion under current policy.
recheck_triggers: current synchronized full-depth capture shows any repeatable net-positive episode after fees and legging risk
new execution path improves atomicity or leg coordination
market depth or opportunity lifetime materially increases
small-capacity episodes reproduce prospectively even if absolute profit is only cents
preserved_negative_evidence: historical external paper is not project PnL proof
midpoint/theoretical combo violations are not executable edge
depth and seconds-long duration are major blockers
entries.scale_note: Low capacity lowers priority only; it does not invalidate a proven positive-EV episode.

entries.title: KWI incomplete-state predictive signal via new mechanism
entries.watch_reason: The simple unweighted incomplete-station mean was falsified in development; the broader early-information mechanism may still be testable by a genuinely orthogonal preregistered method or new holdout.
recheck_triggers: new untouched holdout becomes available
genuinely orthogonal preregistered estimator/mechanism is proposed
source/station publication process materially changes
preserved_negative_evidence: do not retune station subsets or weights on the same development data
simple incomplete mean failed its survival rule

entries.title: Fee-free below-par exhaustive partitions
entries.watch_reason: Earlier work treated very low capacity and long capital lock as economically unattractive. Under the positive-EV policy these are ranking penalties, not admission failures.
recheck_triggers: any formally proven below-par basket with net locked edge > 0 after all frictions
capital lock shortens or collateral is released earlier
capacity/depth increases
same mechanism appears repeatedly across independent markets
preserved_negative_evidence: must prove executable depth and full settlement semantics
capital efficiency remains a ranking factor
entries.scale_note: Cent-level locked profit remains valid research output if reproducible.

entries.title: ForecastEx same-market YES+NO coupon farming
entries.watch_reason: Current Rule 604 net offsetting and observed combined asks prevented the deterministic coupon loop, but this is regime-dependent.
recheck_triggers: Rule 604 or offsetting semantics change
coupon treatment of offsetting positions changes
point-in-time combined executable cost falls below guaranteed coupon-adjusted payout
preserved_negative_evidence: 12.4M-snapshot census found no combined asks under $1 in examined corpus
current same-market net offsetting blocks the simple loop

entries.title: Trueo reward hedge
entries.watch_reason: Mechanism was theoretically interesting but the examined factory had rewardAmount=0.
recheck_triggers: rewardAmount becomes positive
new factory or program introduces economically material rewards
reward terms or hedgeability change
preserved_negative_evidence: zero reward means no current economic route

entries.title: Kalshi soccer HOME/DRAW/AWAY partition
entries.watch_reason: Checked examples were priced above par before fees, but this is instance-dependent pricing rather than a permanent semantic impossibility.
recheck_triggers: new executable three-way basket costs below guaranteed payout after fees
fee schedule changes
new product family creates a cleaner one-hot partition
preserved_negative_evidence: at least 12 checked examples were about 101-105 cents before fees for 100-cent payout

entries.title: Official macro release then stale Kalshi quote
entries.watch_reason: Fed/CPI/payroll families examined closed before official release, eliminating the post-release trading window; other families or future rule changes may differ.
recheck_triggers: market close moves to after official release
new contract family remains executable after a deterministic public release
release or contract timing semantics materially change
preserved_negative_evidence: examined FOMC/CPI/payroll contracts closed before scheduled official release

entries.title: Hourly weather versus daily high/low deterministic identity
entries.watch_reason: The examined families use different settlement sources, so no deterministic identity currently exists.
recheck_triggers: hourly and daily products adopt the same settlement source and transformation
new weather family provides formally identical source semantics
rules materially change rounding/revision/source behavior
preserved_negative_evidence: hourly TWC versus daily NWS source mismatch breaks identity

entries.title: KXHIGHNY six-NO unconditional floor
entries.watch_reason: Standard-path floor existed but exception states prevented an unconditional guarantee.
recheck_triggers: no-data/last-fair-price/MOR exception semantics are removed or materially changed
new contract family has the same standard partition without those exception classes
preserved_negative_evidence: PH-E012 closed the unconditional route under the then-current rules

entries.title: Polymarket ghost-fill atomicity gap
entries.watch_reason: Operational exploitation remains out of scope; monitor only because atomicity changes affect legitimate fill/replay accounting.
recheck_triggers: protocol changes atomic settlement/fill semantics
venue introduces stronger settlement guarantees affecting legitimate execution modeling
preserved_negative_evidence: do not build or test a strategy that intentionally exploits the atomicity gap
